stem.text: The diagram shows a beam supported on two pivots.

stem.alt: Beam curved downwards between two pivots at its ends, with the labels X above the middle of the top surface and Y below the middle of the bottom surface.

stem.text: Which statement describes the state of the top surface X and of the bottom surface Y?

A.text: Both X and Y are in compression.

B.text: Both X and Y are in tension.

C.text: X is in compression and Y is in tension.

D.text: X is in tension and Y is in compression.
